# dotnet-harness-toolkit > Comprehensive .NET development skills with enhanced testing capabilities for modern C#, ASP.NET, MAUI, Blazor, and cloud-native applications [![CI](https://github.com/rudironsoni/dotnet-harness-toolkit/actions/workflows/validate.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/rudironsoni/dotnet-harness-toolkit/actions/workflows/validate.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.4.0-green.svg)](.claude-plugin/plugin.json) ## Overview **dotnet-harness-toolkit** is a Claude Code plugin that provides **149 skills** across **22 categories** and **14 specialist agents** for .NET development. It follows the [Agent Skills](https://github.com/anthropics/agent-skills) open standard for skill authoring and discovery. The plugin covers the full breadth of the .NET ecosystem: - Modern C# patterns, async/await, dependency injection, and source generators - ASP.NET Core APIs, Blazor, MAUI, Uno Platform, WinUI, and WPF - Entity Framework Core, data access strategies, and serialization - Testing with xUnit, TUnit, integration testing, Playwright, and snapshot testing - CI/CD for GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps - Native AOT, trimming, performance profiling, and benchmarking - Security, packaging, documentation, and release management ## Multi-CLI Support This toolkit supports multiple AI CLI tools through [rulesync](https://github.com/dyoshikawa/rulesync): | Tool | Config File | Status | |------|-------------|--------| | **Claude Code** | `CLAUDE.md` | ✅ Generated | | **GitHub Copilot** | `.github/copilot-instructions.md` | ✅ Generated | | **OpenCode** | `opencode.json` | ✅ Generated | | **Gemini CLI** | `.gemini/config.json` | ✅ Generated | | **Codex CLI** | `.codex/config.json` | ✅ Generated | ## Installation ### Claude Code (Primary) From within Claude Code, run: ``` /plugin marketplace add rudironsoni/dotnet-harness-toolkit ``` Once installed, Claude Code automatically loads relevant skills based on your questions about .NET development. ### Other Tools For OpenCode, Gemini CLI, or Codex CLI, copy the respective config file to your project root: ```bash # OpenCode cp opencode.json /path/to/your/project/ # Gemini CLI cp .gemini/config.json /path/to/your/project/.gemini/ # Codex CLI cp .codex/config.json /path/to/your/project/.codex/ ``` ## Rulesync Setup This project uses [rulesync](https://github.com/dyoshikawa/rulesync) to maintain synchronized AI tool configurations. ### Install rulesync ```bash # npm (global) npm install -g rulesync # npx (no install) npx rulesync@latest # Homebrew (macOS) brew install rulesync ``` ### Generate Configs ```bash # Generate all configs npm run rulesync:generate # Or directly rulesync generate --targets claudecode,copilot,opencode,geminicli,codexcli --features rules,mcp,commands,subagents,skills ``` ### Watch Mode ```bash # Auto-regenerate on changes npm run rulesync:watch ``` ## Skill Catalog The plugin organizes **149 skills** into **22 categories**. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard with a `SKILL.md` file containing structured frontmatter and rich guidance content. | Category | Count | Skills | |----------|-------|--------| | **Testing** | 29 | testing-xunit-setup, testing-nsubstitute, testing-autofixture, testing-tunit, testing-tunit-advanced, testing-fluentvalidation, testing-code-coverage, testing-testcontainers, testing-webapi-integration, testing-assertions, testing-naming-conventions, testing-timeprovider, testing-filesystem, testing-output-logging, testing-private-members, testing-object-comparison, testing-data-builders, testing-autodata-xunit, testing-autofixture-nsubstitute, testing-autofixture-bogus, testing-autofixture-customization, testing-xunit-migration, testing-aspnet-integration, testing-aspire, testing-unit-fundamentals, testing-advanced, testing-bogus, testing-overview | | **Core C#** | 18 | csharp-coding-standards, csharp-async-patterns, csharp-concurrency-patterns, csharp-modern-patterns, csharp-dependency-injection, csharp-nullable-reference-types, csharp-type-design-performance, csharp-source-generators, csharp-code-smells, csharp-api-design, csharp-configuration | | **CI/CD** | 12 | gha-patterns, gha-build-test, gha-deploy, gha-publish, ado-patterns, ado-build-test, ado-publish, ado-unique, ci-benchmarking, add-ci | | **UI Frameworks** | 16 | blazor-patterns, blazor-components, blazor-auth, maui-development, maui-aot, uno-platform, uno-targets, uno-mcp, winui, wpf-modern, wpf-migration, winforms-basics, accessibility, ui-chooser, spectre-console, terminal-gui | | **API Development** | 12 | minimal-apis, api-versioning, api-security, api-docs, api-surface-validation, openapi, grpc, http-client, realtime-communication, middleware-patterns, resilience, input-validation | | **Architecture** | 14 | architecture-patterns, aspire-patterns, efcore-patterns, efcore-architecture, domain-modeling, messaging-patterns, background-services, channels, service-communication, validation-patterns, solid-principles, aot-architecture, solution-navigation | | **Performance** | 10 | benchmarkdotnet, profiling, gc-memory, performance-patterns, async-performance-specialist, aot-wasm, native-aot, trimming, build-optimization, native-interop | | **Project Structure** | 8 | project-structure, project-structure-guide, project-analysis, scaffold-project, artifacts-output, modernize, file-based-apps, version-upgrade | | **Native AOT** | 6 | native-aot, trimming, aot-wasm, aot-architecture, maui-aot, native-aot-skill | | **Serialization** | 5 | serialization, serialization-guide, grpc, data-access-strategy | | **Security** | 5 | security-owasp, api-security, secrets-management, cryptography, input-validation | | **CLI Tools** | 8 | system-commandline, cli-architecture, cli-distribution, cli-packaging, cli-tools, tool-management, cli-release-pipeline, windbg-debugging | | **Packaging** | 6 | nuget-authoring, msix, github-releases, packaging, library-api-compat, containers | | **Documentation** | 8 | documentation-strategy, mermaid-diagrams, github-docs, api-docs, xml-docs, documentation, editorconfig | | **Build System** | 6 | msbuild-authoring, msbuild-tasks, build-system, build-optimization, build-analysis, add-analyzers | | **Observability** | 3 | observability, structured-logging, debugging | | **Multi-Targeting** | 4 | multi-targeting, multi-targeting-guide, version-detection, version-upgrade | | **Release Management** | 4 | release-management, release-management-guide, github-releases, versioning | | **Localization** | 2 | localization, localization-guide | | **AI Integration** | 2 | semantic-kernel, ai | | **Agent Meta-Skills** | 6 | agent-gotchas, agent-meta-skills, advisor, build-analysis, csproj-reading, slopwatch | | **Foundation** | 3 | foundation, version-detection, project-analysis | ## Agents The plugin includes **14 specialist agents** that provide focused expertise in specific domains. The central routing agent, `dotnet-architect`, analyzes your query context and delegates to the appropriate specialist. | Agent | Description | |-------|-------------| | **dotnet-architect** | Analyzes project context, requirements, and constraints to recommend architecture approaches, framework choices, and design patterns | | **dotnet-csharp-concurrency-specialist** | Debugs race conditions, deadlocks, thread safety issues, and synchronization problems in .NET code | | **dotnet-security-reviewer** | Reviews .NET code for security vulnerabilities, OWASP compliance, secrets exposure, and cryptographic misuse | | **dotnet-blazor-specialist** | Guides Blazor development across all hosting models (Server, WASM, Hybrid, Auto) including components, state, and auth | | **dotnet-uno-specialist** | Builds cross-platform Uno Platform apps with Extensions ecosystem, MVUX patterns, Toolkit controls, and MCP integration | | **dotnet-maui-specialist** | Builds .NET MAUI apps with platform-specific development, Xamarin migration, and Native AOT on iOS/Catalyst | | **dotnet-performance-analyst** | Analyzes profiling data, benchmark results, GC behavior, and diagnoses performance bottlenecks | | **dotnet-benchmark-designer** | Designs BenchmarkDotNet benchmarks, prevents measurement bias, and validates benchmark methodology | | **dotnet-docs-generator** | Generates documentation including Mermaid diagrams, XML doc skeletons, and GitHub-native docs | | **dotnet-async-performance-specialist** | Analyzes ValueTask correctness, ConfigureAwait decisions, async overhead, ThreadPool tuning | | **dotnet-aspnetcore-specialist** | Guides middleware authoring, DI patterns, minimal API design, and request pipeline optimization | | **dotnet-testing-specialist** | Designs test pyramids, unit vs integration vs E2E boundaries, test data management | | **dotnet-cloud-specialist** | Guides .NET Aspire orchestration, AKS deployment, distributed tracing, infrastructure-as-code | | **dotnet-code-review-agent** | Performs multi-dimensional code review across correctness, performance, security, and architecture | ## Architecture ### Plugin Structure ``` dotnet-harness-toolkit/ ├── .claude-plugin/ │ └── plugin.json # Plugin manifest ├── skills/ # 149 flat skills │ ├── testing-*/ # Testing skills (29) │ ├── csharp-*/ # C# skills (18) │ └── ... # Other categories ├── agents/ # 14 specialist agents │ ├── dotnet-architect.md │ └── ... ├── .rulesync/ # Rulesync configuration │ ├── rules/ # Shared rules │ ├── mcp.json # MCP configuration │ └── ... ├── CLAUDE.md # Claude Code config ├── opencode.json # OpenCode config └── rulesync.jsonc # Rulesync manifest ``` ### Agent Delegation Flow ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant User participant Claude as Claude Code participant Router as dotnet-architect
(Routing Agent) participant Specialist as Specialist Agent participant Skills as Skill Files User->>Claude: "How do I set up Blazor auth?" Claude->>Router: Route query Router->>Router: Load advisor catalog
+ analyze query context Router->>Specialist: Delegate to blazor-specialist Specialist->>Skills: Load blazor-auth
+ blazor-patterns Skills-->>Specialist: Skill content Specialist-->>Claude: Structured guidance Claude-->>User: Blazor auth recommendation
with code examples ``` ## Usage Examples **Ask about project architecture:** > "I have a new .NET 9 web API project. What architecture pattern should I use for a medium-sized e-commerce backend?" Claude Code loads `architecture-patterns` and `project-structure` to recommend a clean architecture approach with specific project layout, middleware pipeline, and dependency injection configuration. **Debug a concurrency issue:** > "I'm getting intermittent failures in my background service that processes messages from a queue. Sometimes messages are processed twice." The `dotnet-csharp-concurrency-specialist` agent activates, loading `csharp-async-patterns` and `background-services` to diagnose the race condition and recommend idempotency patterns. **Set up CI/CD:** > "Help me create a GitHub Actions workflow that builds, tests, and publishes my NuGet package." Claude Code loads `gha-build-test` and `gha-publish` to generate a complete workflow with proper versioning, test matrix, and NuGet push configuration. ## Development Workflow ### Adding a New Skill 1. Create a new directory under `skills/` 2. Add `SKILL.md` with proper frontmatter: ```yaml --- name: your-skill-name description: "Clear, concise description under 120 chars" invocable: false --- ``` 3. Include ## Scope and ## Out of scope sections 4. Run `just validate` to verify 5. Run `just test` to regenerate configs ### Running Validation ```bash # Run all validations just validate # Individual validations just validate-plugin # Validate plugin structure just validate-markdown # Validate SKILL.md files just validate-cross-refs # Check cross-references just validate-rulesync # Validate rulesync config ``` ### Regenerating Configs After modifying skills or rules, regenerate all AI tool configs: ```bash just test ``` ## Testing The project includes comprehensive testing infrastructure to verify agent routing and skill discovery across Claude, Codex, and Copilot. ### Test Infrastructure | Component | Description | |-----------|-------------| | `just test-agent-routing` | Run all agent routing tests | | `tests/agent-routing/cases.json` | Broad case corpus with test prompts | | `tests/agent-routing/check-skills.cs` | Single .NET file-based runner | | `tests/agent-routing/provider-baseline.json` | Expected outcomes per provider for CI gating | ### Running Tests ```bash # Run all agent routing tests just test-agent-routing # Run all tests including validation just test # Test specific agents just test-agent codex just test-agent claude # Pass additional arguments just test-agent codex --category api just test-agent claude --case-id uno-mcp-routing-skill-id-only --timeout-seconds 180 # Skip source setup (for debugging) just test-agent-routing --skip-source-setup --agents claude --case-id advisor-routing-maintainable-app ``` ### Test Configuration Tests verify that agents: 1. Discover the correct skills based on user queries 2. Load expected skill files (`SKILL.md`) 3. Use appropriate tools and patterns **Evidence Evaluation:** - **Claude**: Checks for `"Launching skill: "` or `{"skill":""}` tokens - **Codex/Copilot**: Checks for `"/SKILL.md"` file paths ### CI Testing The `.github/workflows/agent-live-routing.yml` workflow runs scheduled tests with a provider matrix. Tests gate on `provider-baseline.json` which defines expected outcomes per case/provider. ### Test Artifacts Results are written to `tests/agent-routing/artifacts//`: - `results.json` - Test results with pass/fail/infra_error status - `tool-use-proof.log` - Matched tool-use evidence lines Parse the artifact directory from stderr: ```bash grep '^ARTIFACT_DIR=' stderr.log | cut -d= -f2- ``` ## Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING-SKILLS.md](CONTRIBUTING-SKILLS.md) for the skill authoring guide, or [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the general contribution workflow. ### Skill Authoring Guidelines - **Flat structure**: All skills are at `skills/` root, no category folders - **Naming**: Use kebab-case (e.g., `testing-xunit-setup`) - **Frontmatter**: Only `name`, `description`, and `invocable` fields - **Description**: Maximum 120 characters - **Sections**: Must include ## Scope and ## Out of scope - **Cross-references**: Use `[skill:skill-name]` format ## Acknowledgments Testing skills are based on ".NET Testing Agent Skills" by Kevin Tseng ([@kevintsengtw](https://github.com/kevintsengtw)), originally from the 2025 iThome Ironman Software Development Competition Champion work. - Testing skills source: https://github.com/kevintsengtw/dotnet-testing-agent-skills ## License This project is licensed under the MIT License. See the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details.
